stem_book: A small block of mass 20 kg rests on a bigger block of mass 30 kg, which lies on a smooth horizontal plane. Initially the whole system is at rest. The coefficient of friction between the blocks is 0.5. The horizontal force F = 50 N is applied on the lower block. Find the work done (in J) by friction force on upper block in t = 2 s. (g = 10 m/s²)
